quarantines.subject: HA Issue 08 extra-string formula against the explicit PV25 pair
quarantines.meaning: HA Issue 08 p. 11 gives the extra-string formula 32344 + 2n / 32345 + 2n with n = 1…4. P. 13 explicitly starts PV25 at 32344/32345, contradicting that formula's first pair. Preserve the literal table and formula separately; no silent index correction.

quarantines.subject: HA Issue 08 PV15 current listed twice, PV14 current absent
quarantines.meaning: P. 12 duplicates PV15 current 32045 and omits a distinct PV14-current row.

quarantines.subject: HD Issue 01 second-bank formula origin
quarantines.meaning: HD Issue 01 p. 11 gives a second-bank formula without a resolved local-index origin in the inspected scope. P. 13 supplies explicit PV25–36 pairs; use those source rows rather than an inferred formula origin.

quarantines.subject: MB02 35010 alarm name against a voltage unit
quarantines.meaning: MB02 p. 29 names 35010 as an alarm but gives unit V; the semantic label is quarantined.

quarantines.subject: MB02 optimizer feature-table caption against its version cell
quarantines.meaning: Its pp. 70–71 optimizer table has a V102 caption and V103 version cell; the 108-byte format selection is unresolved.

quarantines.subject: MB02 literal PSC110 floor suffix
quarantines.meaning: Its literal PSC110 firmware suffix is not rewritten to SPC110.

quarantines.subject: MA-V200 phase-power rows with an energy unit
quarantines.meaning: MA-V200 phase-power-labelled 32133/32135/32137 carry literal kWh units (p.26); their meaning is quarantined rather than silently changing the unit to kW.

quarantines.subject: MA-V200 and MC optimizer feature-table caption against its version cell
quarantines.meaning: Both sources describe optimizer files with a V102 caption/V103 version-cell conflict for 108-byte feature records.

quarantines.subject: Model row numbered by a sequence ordinal, not a model identifier
quarantines.meaning: The edition numbers this row with a sequence ordinal that it does not label as a model identifier. The ordinal is kept as the sequence number and is never used as a model identifier.

quarantines.subject: Minimum-software cell outside the branch form
quarantines.meaning: The row minimum is a merged cell or a literal outside the V-R-C-SPC form. The literal is kept as printed and serves as no floor until the cell is clarified from the edition.

quarantines.subject: 35318 / 35320 event-time fields
quarantines.evidence: G03 p. 18: U16 and 2 words; G07 p. 18: U32 and 2 words
quarantines.meaning: G03 tuple is inconsistent with ordinary U16 width. No automatic U32 repair or inferred firmware cutoff.

quarantines.subject: 30083 / 30085 ratings
quarantines.evidence: LB08 p. 11: I32, kVar, gain 1000; HD01 p. 10: U32, kW / kVA, gain 1000
quarantines.meaning: Full wrapped LB cells confirm the dimensional mismatch. Retain variants; no shared rating decoder.

quarantines.subject: 40200 / 40201 commands
quarantines.meaning: Readback/access remain source-specific. A shared address does not grant read permission or retry safety.

quarantines.subject: Reactive regulation coherent read
quarantines.meaning: Keep distinct exact-edition read groups; no universal end address.

quarantines.subject: Product selector 47000
quarantines.evidence: L05 p. 14: zero/nonzero distinction; M10 p. 66: explicit vendor/product values
quarantines.meaning: Configuration evidence does not prove installed or active storage.

quarantines.subject: FC10 quantity
quarantines.meaning: Zero-length writing is not endorsed; lower-bound anomaly stays unresolved.

quarantines.subject: Storage power control47321
quarantines.evidence: M10 p.32: INT32/1 word; MA-V200 p.106 and MAP10 p.106: I32/2 words. Earlier/later inspected MA-C00 editions retain1.
quarantines.meaning: Unresolved edition conflict. Quarantine the inconsistent M10 row; preserve the consistent MA-V200 tuple in its own scope. No primary erratum or explicit cross-edition resolution found.
